title: Service-level authentication and authorization procedure initiation

entities.name: Service-level authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the SMF for service-level authentication and authorization, involving sending a SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message to the UE.

entities.name: SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message created by the SMF to initiate service-level authentication and authorization, containing the Service-level-AA container IE.

entities.name: PTI IE
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identity information element in the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message, set to 'No procedure transaction identity assigned'.

entities.name: Service-level-AA container IE
entities.description: Information element in the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message that carries the service-level-AA payload provided by the DN.

entities.name: Timer T3xyz
entities.description: Timer started by the SMF upon sending the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message; exact specification is pending.

entities.name: PTI set to 'No procedure transaction identity assigned'
entities.description: Condition where the PTI IE in the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message is set to indicate no procedure transaction identity is assigned.

entities.name: SMF sends SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Action where the SMF transmits the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message to the UE.

entities.name: UE passes service-level-AA payload to upper layers
entities.description: Action where the UE, upon receiving the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message, forwards the service-level-AA payload from the Service-level-AA container IE to upper layers.

relations.description: The service-level authentication and authorization procedure includes sending the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
The SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message contains the PTI IE.
The SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message contains the Service-level-AA container IE.
The PTI IE is set to the condition 'No procedure transaction identity assigned'.
The SMF starts timer T3xyz when sending the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
The procedure includes the SMF sending the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
The procedure includes the UE passing the service-level-AA payload to upper layers upon message receipt.
